reason: The dataset contains 4,005 talk-level catalog rows with aggregate popularity metrics ('views', 'comments'), but zero user IDs, session logs, explicit ratings, or individual watch histories. Without a genuine bipartite user-item interaction matrix, Collaborative Filtering cannot be trained or evaluated. No synthetic users or fake interactions were fabricated.

Content-Based Filtering.data_requirements: Item metadata, transcripts, topic tags (all available)
Content-Based Filtering.cold_start: Works immediately for new talks with text/tags; no user history needed
Content-Based Filtering.personalization: Content/query-driven; aligns with explicit talk or text query
Content-Based Filtering.explainability: High (shared TF-IDF terms and matching topic tags)

Collaborative Filtering.data_requirements: Bipartite user-item interactions (unavailable in current dataset)
Collaborative Filtering.cold_start: Suffers from both new-user and new-item cold-start problems
Collaborative Filtering.personalization: Strong serendipity & latent taste modeling when user logs exist
Collaborative Filtering.explainability: Moderate to Low (neighborhood or latent factor weights)
